title: AI Prompt Guard scan request (apg_scan_json)
description: Structured request of apg_scan_json(). Unknown keys are rejected (APG_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT) so that a typo can never silently disable a check. Either "text" or "fields" must be present. apg_scan_text() is the shortcut for {"text": ..., "source": ...}.

request_id.description: Echoed back in the result; never interpreted. Do not put secrets here.

source.description: Where the text comes from. Known sources: user_input (default), tool_output, rag_document, agent_message. An unknown source is accepted, only the generic 'content' rules apply and a warning is returned.

role.description: Informational only (e.g. user, assistant, tool); not used for detection.

text.description: The primary text. UTF-8; U+0000 is allowed. Larger than limits.max_text_bytes -> structured error result.

fields.description: Additional named inputs that rules can be bound to (e.g. tool_name, tool_args, tool_description, tool_response, agent_output). A field that no rule reads is reported in inputs.fields_ignored and is NOT scanned.

context.description: Scalar facts about the request that context-dependent rules require, e.g. {"task": "translation"}. A rule that requires a context key which is absent is reported in needs_context instead of matching.
